researchQuestion: Which coordinate should represent Møllebyen / Moss by- og industrimuseum without confusing the historic industrial district, museum, waterfall or nearby Moss Ironworks?

result.decisionSummary: Use the independently stated Møllebyen district coordinate. Keep Moss by- og industrimuseum as a visitor and interpretation anchor approximately 22 metres away, not as a replacement for the whole district.
